player_outcome_model_manifest.conditioning: event type plus joint yards-bin and touchdown label; result sampled before state transition
player_outcome_model_manifest.source: nflverse nfl_pbp pass, rush, sack, completion and interception fields; participant keys are GSIS ids
player_outcome_model_manifest.transfer_rule: outcome observations are retained by stable player id; QB decision tendencies are separately keyed by team and QB
player_outcome_model_manifest.yardage_fallback: a missing role-specific player yard field omits that result adjustment; emitted box-score yards use yards_gained when the source field is null

player_share_model_manifest.eligibility_rule: a rostered player listed Out or Doubtful on the frozen injury report is not eligible; Questionable and players with no report stay eligible; position-conditioned shares re-normalise within the selected eligible group

qb_decision_model_manifest.qb_run_role_definition: primary-QB rush_attempt rows with play_type=run, excluding explicit scrambles, dropbacks, penalties and two-point attempts; qb_kneel rows are excluded by play_type. The residual can include QB sneaks because the source does not identify them separately.
qb_decision_model_manifest.qb_run_role_exposure: team run plays in games where the QB had the most recorded dropbacks; ties between primary passers are excluded
qb_decision_model_manifest.qb_run_role_style: player-versus-team log-odds adjustment to the team QB run-role prior, with 20-opportunity shrinkage

qb_sneak_classification.reason: the nfl_pbp table used by this fit has no qb_sneak field or play description, so sneaks cannot be separated in this model input

qb_decision_model_manifest.scramble_definition: qb_scramble among nflverse qb_dropback rows; scrambler identity uses rusher_player_id joined by GSIS id when its canonical position is QB
qb_decision_model_manifest.source: nfl_pbp qb_dropback, qb_scramble, pass_attempt, rush_attempt, penalty, two_point_attempt and play_type; canonical QB, rusher and receiver positions joined by GSIS id
qb_decision_model_manifest.transfer_rule: QB decision histories remain keyed by team and passer; a new team uses its team and league priors

rng_protocol.stream_key: stream_root_sha256 (code and artifact hashes are provenance only)

field_semantics.drive_window_seconds: Elapsed time from each drive start state to its end state; separately reported from summed per-play possession clock.
field_semantics.fourth_down_attempts: Scrimmage plays that began on fourth down; punts and field-goal attempts are excluded from go-for-it attempts.
field_semantics.lineup_player_snaps: Modeled RB/FB/WR/TE lineup appearances only; QB and linemen excluded and production chosen independently.
field_semantics.observed_overtime_touchdowns: Offensive touchdowns on observed overtime drives without play or player attribution.
field_semantics.offensive_success_rate: Down-based success: at least 40% of yards-to-go on first down, 60% on second, chains on third/fourth; touchdowns count as successful plays.
field_semantics.other_score_points: Non-touchdown, non-safety score-ledger points, including field goals.
field_semantics.possession_seconds: Sum of recorded per-play game-clock intervals while this team had possession; reconciled separately with drive windows and kickoff clock time.
field_semantics.red_zone_field_goals: Made field goals; alias of red_zone_field_goals_made.
field_semantics.snaps: Starting QB: team scrimmage plays. RB, FB, WR, TE: lineup-model count. Null for linemen and defenders, which are not modeled.
field_semantics.starter: Frozen depth-chart role, not evidence of playing time.
field_semantics.targets: Assigned receivers on pass attempts; throwaways and spikes are not modeled, so targets generally equal attempts.
field_semantics.third_down_attempts: Scrimmage plays that began on third down; conversions require a same-possession transition to a new first down.
field_semantics.try_points: Touchdown drive ledger points above six, not a count of try attempts.

boxscore.player_note: Participants are selected from the frozen pregame roster before the outcome. qb, receiver, rusher outcome rows are reweighted by cutoff-safe player distributions before the game-state transition. Box-score passing, receiving and rushing yards use their corresponding nflverse fields when present; the state transition uses yards_gained. This is a research projection layer; historical source outcomes and the current model do not establish calibrated forecasts.

quarter_by_quarter.player_stats_scope: players_with_period_activity; omitted roster players have zero period stats

realism.lineup_semantics: player_snaps counts modeled RB/FB/WR/TE lineup appearances only, not full player snaps; production is selected independently.
